title: Composite derived unit with successive-pushforward source
statement: For composable scheme maps s:A→B and t:B→D, with the three derived module categories in a common morphism universe, and every homotopy object K, define schemeMVCompositionUnit s t K to be the existing right-derived unit of (s≫t)_*, with source Q(t_*(s_*K)) and target R(s≫t)_*(QK). The source is definitionally the same as Q((s≫t)_*K), since pushforwardComp is the identity on sections. This is a fixed construction, not a choice. The derived-category conventions are [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data].

lean.statement:
def schemeMVCompositionUnit {A B D : Scheme.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings B.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings D.toRingedSpace))]
    (s : A ⟶ B) (t : B ⟶ D)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    (fun {V W : Type _} [Category V] [Category W] {P Q : V ⥤ W}
      (_ : P ⟶ Q) (J : V) ↦ P.obj J)
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage t.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage s.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ⟶
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (s ≫ t)).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K)
